doc.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jimmy played cornet, not trumpet or flugelhorn
summary: Jimmy preferred the cornet's tone; she bought him a flugelhorn but he played it only a few times.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Did Jimmy play the cornet exclusively?
Did he ever play flugelhorn? Ever play trumpet? Never saw him . . .

He did play trumpet, but he didn’t like it. He liked . . . he started very early . . . he really kept to the cornet, because he liked the tone better. Although I did buy him a flugelhorn. He kept saying he’d like to try the flugelhorn, but by the time I bought it for him, I think he wasn’t that interested. He didn’t . . . he played it a few times, but he didn’t really go into it very eagerly. He just kept to the cornet.
